post.description: Process webhook events from any configured payment gateway

parameters.description: Gateway name (stripe, paypal, esewa, khalti, etc.)
parameters.name: gateway

fixed_fee.description:
Fixed fee charged by gateway
example: 0.30

percentage_fee.description:
Percentage fee charged by gateway
example: 2.9

role_name.description: Only allow staff or manager roles

billed_amount.description: Manual amount to bill (if not auto-calculating)

api_key.description:
API Key for the payment gateway (will be encrypted)
required: true
example: sk_test_...

api_secret.description:
API Secret for the payment gateway (will be encrypted)
required: true
example: sk_secret_...

display_name.description:
Human-readable display name
required: true
example: Stripe Payment Gateway

fixed_fee.description:
Fixed fee charged by the gateway (e.g., 0.30)
required: false
example: 0.30

gateway_name.description:
Gateway type identifier (stripe, paypal, esewa, khalti)
required: true
example: stripe

is_enabled.description:
Whether this gateway is enabled for use
required: false
example: true

is_test_mode.description:
Whether this gateway is in test/sandbox mode
required: false
example: false

max_amount.description:
Maximum transaction amount allowed
required: false
example: 10000.00

min_amount.description:
Minimum transaction amount allowed
required: false
example: 1.00

percentage_fee.description:
Percentage fee charged by the gateway (e.g., 2.9 for 2.9%)
required: false
example: 2.9

priority.description:
Priority for gateway selection (lower = higher priority)
required: false
example: 1

supported_countries.description:
List of supported country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
required: false
example: ["US","GB","NP"]

supported_currencies.description:
List of supported currency codes (ISO 4217)
required: false
example: ["USD","EUR","NPR"]

webhook_secret.description:
Webhook Secret for verifying gateway callbacks (will be encrypted)
required: true
example: whsec_...
